violation_type.title: Field Trips - Caregivers Easily Identifiable (26 TAC §746.3001(7))
violation_type.typical_finding: Based on information obtained through the investigation, Caregivers were not easily identifiable by all children attending the field trip.

finding_variants.text: Based on information obtained through the investigation, Caregivers were not easily identifiable by all children attending the field trip.
Based on the evidence obtained during the investigation, the caregivers were not easily identifiable.

While speaking to the director about field trips, it was determined that the staff does not wear easily identifiable items. This was corrected at inspection when I spoke to the director about the necessary identification the staff needs.
Caregivers were observed walking back from a field trip to the library without any way to easily identify themselves to the children.
Based on observation, a group returned from a field trip and the three caregivers present did not have anything on their persons that made them easily identifiable to all children present.
There is enough evidence to determine that one of the two caregivers who were on the field trip didn't have a camp shirt or lanyard etc. to easily identify the teacher as part of the field trip.
